reports.question: I want to make a pixel game with AI. Where do I start?

sections.readingReply:
### Follow one short tutorial, step by step

See how movement works, then explore jumping and platform collisions. Treat each part as a small exercise and ask AI to explain what you observe.

sections.readingReply:
### Sketch one tiny world

Try a 16×16 character and a two-color scene. Finish a single room where you can walk and jump, then develop the visual details.

*Fictional demo reply · Sample sources*
sections.prompt: 我想用 AI 做一个像素小游戏，应该从哪里开始？
sections.platformPrompt: 我想用 AI 做一个像素小游戏，应该从哪里开始？
sections.rawReply:
### 先画一个简单的小世界

用 16×16 的角色和两种颜色搭出场景。先完成一个能走、能跳的小房间，再逐步丰富画面。

*虚构演示回复 · 示例来源*

sections.readingReply:
### Keep the first game small

Make one room with one goal. Write down “move, jump, land,” then use AI to help debug each part.

*Fictional demo reply · Sample sources*

materials.title: Your first pixel game with AI

source.markdown:
![Pixel character and platforms: fictional tutorial artwork](https://postrove-demo.example/pixel-game.png)

## Make one character move

[00:00 · Set up the scene](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEMO1234abc&t=0s)　 [02:14 · Move and jump](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEMO1234abc&t=134s)　 [05:32 · Platform collisions](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEMO1234abc&t=332s)

Begin with a tiny scene: move left and right, press space to jump, and land on a platform. Run each small change and observe what happens.

```text
Character: move left/right → press space to jump
Scene: one platform → check landing collisions
```

**Ask AI next:** “Break a character jump into three small steps and explain each one.”

*Fictional demo material and placeholder sources illustrate the reading workflow.*
